acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce or explicitly bound fresh-HOME EEXIST on pinned TestCafe3.7.6 macOS; distinguish confirmed failure from suspected helper-copy race.
A durable bounded setup or documented unsupported profile preserves native failure; never report tests passed after helper startup failure.
Actual fresh-HOME repeated runs retain native report and exit, and clean up owned browser/helper descendants.
body:
Confirmed qualification friction; suspected concurrent upstream helper-copy root cause, not proven. TestCafe3.7.6, Node22.23.3, Chrome154.0.8037.59 macOS headless remote. Run exact retained plan via pinned common executor with fresh isolated HOME and connect remote Chrome. Native console reports EEXIST mkdir .home/.testcafe-browser-tools/TestCafe Browser Tools.app/Contents; repeated native-app-copy-error-fresh retains same failure. Expected first-use helper setup succeeds or produces classified infrastructure failure; actual native run aborted before useful test results. Synchronous task-owned copy of bundled helper permitted later actual mixed PASSED/FAILED/SKIPPED qualification, but is setup workaround rather than durable framework fix. Investigate/contain in documented optional TestCafe adapter setup; do not mutate shared global HOME.
